description_en: Queries the status of a trail
kebab_example: aliyun actiontrail get-trail-status --name trail-test --is-organization-trail false --api-version 2020-07-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTrailStatus

parameters.help_en:
The name of the trail.

The name must be 6 to 36 characters in length. The name must start with a lowercase letter and can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

The name must be unique within your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
跟踪名称。  
长度为6～36个字符，必须以小写英文字母开头，可包含小写英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。  

同一账号内跟踪名称不可重复
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the status of a multi-account trail. Valid values:

true: Query the status of a multi-account trail.

false: Query the status of a single-account trail. It is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询多账号跟踪状态，取值：  

true：查询多账号跟踪状态。

false（默认值）：查单账号跟踪状态
parameters.name: is_organization_trail

IsLogging.description_en:
Indicates whether logging is enabled for the trail. Valid values:

true

false
IsLogging.description_zh:
是否开启日志记录，取值：

true：开启。  
false：关闭

LatestDeliveryError.description_en: The log of the last failed delivery
LatestDeliveryError.description_zh: 最近一次行为跟踪异常的日志信息
LatestDeliveryError.example: write sls failed, exception: the parent of sub user must be project owner, itemscount: 1

LatestDeliveryLogServiceError.description_en: The log of the last failed delivery to Log Service
LatestDeliveryLogServiceError.description_zh: 最近一次投递日志服务的错误信息
LatestDeliveryLogServiceError.example: write sls failed, exception: the parent of sub user must be project owner, itemscount: 1

LatestDeliveryLogServiceTime.description_en: The most recent time when an event was delivered to Log Service
LatestDeliveryLogServiceTime.description_zh: 最近一次成功投递日志服务的时间

LatestDeliveryTime.description_en: The most recent time when an event was delivered by the trail
LatestDeliveryTime.description_zh: 最近一次成功记录行为的时间

OssBucketStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the destination Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket is available. Valid values:

true

false
OssBucketStatus.description_zh:
OSS存储空间是否可用，取值：

true：可用。
false：不可用

SlsLogStoreStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the destination Log Service Logstore is available. Valid values:

true

false
SlsLogStoreStatus.description_zh:
SLS Logstore是否可用，取值：

true：可用。  
false：不可用

StartLoggingTime.description_en: The time when logging was last enabled for the trail
StartLoggingTime.description_zh: 最近一次开启跟踪的时间

StopLoggingTime.description_en: The time when logging was last disabled for the trail
StopLoggingTime.description_zh: 最近一次停止跟踪的时间
